info.title: Crew core integration API
info.description: Bounded core integration surface. This document is not the complete Crew API. See x-excluded-routes for the current v1 routes outside its scope. UTF-8 byte bounds and control-character restrictions are enforced by the shared runtime schemas and described with x- extensions.

instructionPacks.description: Instruction pack UUIDs in model reading order, each once.
Instruction pack UUIDs in model reading order, each once.

CommandUnavailable.description: The command outcome is unknown. Reconcile the original identity; retry_same_request requires the same request.

get.description: Every active grant for the authenticated owner's member, plus at most twenty inactive rows. No pagination or active-result truncation. A read does not acknowledge an earlier revoke command.

post.description: Idempotently revoke the exact member/grant identity for later proposals only. Requires an empty JSON object. Already approved calls remain approved. Lost acknowledgement remains an unknown command outcome.

409.description: The command outcome is unknown for update_rejected. Reconcile the original identity. Other codes follow the ordinary command error rules.

post.description: One handoff attempt using the saved source conversation, requestId and target member. A successful response proves commit. firstRequestAdmitted reports admission, not execution. Reconcile unknown outcomes against the exact outgoing command before an explicit same-identity retry.

get.description: Read incoming and outgoing handoffs for the owner's conversation. A 404 or incoming-only response does not settle an earlier unknown outgoing command. Compare the outgoing source conversation, requestId and target member with the saved command.

post.description: One admission attempt. Preserve requestId and exact UTF-8 text for reconciliation. Acceptance does not prove completion or effects.
Durable cancellation intent. Delivery, native termination and effects are independent facts. This does not claim rollback.

get.description: Owner-only immutable complete record_work_item proposal, retained after settlement. Exact conversation, member, request, invocation, approval and decision version required. Unknown or repeated query parameters are rejected. Unsupported tools and scope mismatches return not_found. This read does not claim actionability or change approvals, grants, deadlines or effects. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

post.description: Official AG-UI snapshot and bounded event tail. threadId must match conversationId. messages, tools and context must be empty, state and forwardedProps empty or null, and resume absent or empty. Reconnect with a fresh snapshot after cursor expiry. This route never submits work.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: If supplied, must equal the current snapshot cursor as a decimal string.

200.description: AG-UI Server-Sent Events encoded by @ag-ui/encoder 1.0.4. Each data frame is an official AG-UI event; optional id is the persisted cursor.
